name: Wand to Bethor
summary: At Fenris Keep, the confrontation ends with the Woven Wand bound for Bethor Iceshard. Three apprentice mages made it as a sign of fellowship, but Thule Ravenclaw hid it after choosing the Scourge. Its return brings a piece of Bethor's mortal youth back to the Undercity.

sections.title: A Token of Fractured Fellowship
sections.body: Before Lordaeron fell, three young mages joined their training wands into one, the Woven Wand. It marked their friendship and shared hopes in the magical arts. Thule Ravenclaw later gave his loyalty to the Lich King and embraced the Scourge, breaking their fellowship. He came to despise the friendship they had shared, yet could not destroy the wand or leave it with his former companions.

sections.title: Hidden in the Keep
sections.body: Thule Ravenclaw carried the Woven Wand to Fenris Isle and hid it on a dusty shelf inside Fenris Keep. The wand lay untouched for years, its enchantment dormant. Bethor noted that using its magic would have revealed its whereabouts at once. Returning it to the Magic Quarter of the Undercity gives Bethor a keepsake of his mortal youth, recovered from the lair of a traitor who could neither love his friends nor let them go.

faq.answer: The Woven Wand is a magical tool made long ago by Thule Ravenclaw, Bethor Iceshard, and a third apprentice mage. Each gave an early training wand, and the three were woven together as a sign of their friendship and shared arcane studies.

faq.q: Why did Thule Ravenclaw steal the wand?
faq.answer: When Thule Ravenclaw turned to the Lich King, his bond with the other mages broke. He came to hate what the wand represented, yet would not part with it or let Bethor and their other companion keep it. He hid the wand on Fenris Isle.

Bethor Iceshard is a powerful Forsaken mage who lives in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. Before Lordaeron fell, he was Thule Ravenclaw's peer and friend. Thule later surrendered his will to the Scourge.

faq.q: Why didn't Thule use the Woven Wand's magic?
faq.answer: Bethor would have sensed the wand's enchantment across the arcane weave if Thule had used it. Thule left its power untouched on a forgotten shelf in Fenris Keep, keeping the wand out of spite and possessiveness.

faq.q: Who was the third apprentice who helped make the wand?
faq.answer: Gunther Arcanus was the third apprentice who joined his wand with Bethor's and Thule's, long before Thule betrayed them.

faq.q: Where did the wand end up before being found?
faq.answer: Thule Ravenclaw hid the wand on a dusty shelf in a hidden niche inside Fenris Keep on Fenris Isle. He had established his Scourge operations in that stronghold.

angles.text: For a mage, the Woven Wand recalls an arcane tradition: apprentice mages joining their foci in fellowship. The Scourge shattered that innocence when it tore Dalaran and Lordaeron apart.
As one of the Forsaken, you may see old artifacts as reminders of mortal hopes and former friends. Bethor's keepsake recalls those who chose the Lich King's tyranny over free will.
